recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a male figure in dark formal attire leaning against a dark luxury convertible, set against a stark, blown-out white background. The composition features a prominent typographic block in the upper left corner and a standard advisory label in the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against the car creates a diagonal tension against the vertical frame.
Dark silhouette of the figure and car against a pure white void.
Horizontal typographic block balances the verticality of the standing figure.
coreInvariants: High-key white background with zero detail.
Deep black clothing with subtle texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait, slightly off-center to the right, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the subject's blazer and the hood of the car.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top-left text, moves down the subject's face, follows the arm to the car, and ends at the bottom-right advisory label.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the subject and car, creating a 'cut-out' effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark navy blues in the clothing and car paint.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and metallic highlights on the car and jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between the subject and the background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Hyphen elongated to match the width of the characters

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a white box with a black border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different weights and sizes within a bordered container.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, wide geometric feel of late 90s hip hop design.
Provides the necessary horizontal weight and modern aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a black blazer and black polo shirt leaning against the hood of a dark blue luxury convertible car. The entire scene is set against a solid, bright white studio background with no floor detail. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white rectangular box in the top left corner with a thin black border. Inside, place two lines of ultra-extended, bold, dark navy sans-serif text. Add a standard black and white parental advisory label in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the subject wearing all black?
Is the car a dark-colored convertible?

adjustableVariables: Navy blue vs. Black text color
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text box does not overlap the subject's face.
Check that the car's reflection doesn't show a studio environment.
Verify the white background is completely blown out to #FFFFFF.
Confirm the typography feels horizontally 'crushed' or extended.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast portrait of a figure in dark clothing against a white void, then anchor the composition with a bordered block of ultra-extended sans-serif type in the upper corner.
